content: Yesuꞌa aꞌmo lagaugefeꞌmo lusi neꞌyaꞌmo kaeꞌnaya kavafeꞌmo aeno kalafefa gemo huꞌniya gemae

Halate Yesuꞌa aeno kalafefa gemo huno hapa painoꞌaeꞌmo, Gotiꞌa yagaino neꞌapateya kavaꞌmo haneꞌniya kava huno mago ala neꞌapimo kini neꞌmoꞌa mafaꞌneꞌamo aꞌmo aligefe huꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo mafaꞌneꞌamo lusi neꞌyaꞌmo kaeno ateꞌniye.

Agaemo aliꞌyaꞌamo neꞌaliya vayaꞌmo alino apateꞌnigeꞌa uꞌa eyo huno ge huꞌniya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo hapa paiꞌapaeꞌmo, yahauve neꞌmoꞌa ago neꞌyaꞌmo kaeꞌniyanagi eyo, huno huꞌniye, huꞌa hapa paiꞌnayaꞌmonanafa oꞌafiꞌnae.

Agaemo magoꞌe huno aliꞌyaꞌamo neꞌaliya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo, eyo huꞌna ge huꞌnova vayaꞌaifeꞌmo utapa hapa paitapaeꞌmo, neꞌyaꞌmo ago yagita huno maleꞌniye. Alopa pulumakaꞌe aikeli pulumakaꞌeꞌmo heno kae maleꞌniyanagi aꞌmo alisiya neꞌyategamo eyo, hutapa hapa paiyo, huno hapa paiteno alino apateꞌnigeꞌa uꞌa hapa paiꞌnae.
Uꞌa hapa paiꞌnayaꞌmonanafa geꞌapimo oꞌafiꞌa atagu faeꞌa u eꞌa huꞌnae. Mago vekamo hoyaꞌalega uꞌnigeno mago vekamo aliꞌyaꞌalega uꞌniye.
Mago vayaꞌamogi ala neꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌamo neꞌaliya vayaꞌmo apatafauꞌa huꞌa faipa huꞌa apateteꞌa kamiti apamagiꞌnae.
Ala neꞌapimo kini vekamoꞌa lusi kava huno aipamo leꞌnigeno ati vayaꞌamo alino apateꞌnigeꞌa uꞌa vayaꞌamo hapaeꞌnaya vayaꞌmo hapaeꞌa hano huꞌa apataleteꞌa taoniꞌapimo ata kaeꞌa ataleꞌnae.

Agaemo aliꞌyaꞌamo neꞌaliya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo hapa painoꞌaeꞌmo, mafaꞌneꞌnimoꞌmo aꞌmo aligefe huꞌnigeꞌna yagita huꞌnovaꞌmonanafa eyo huꞌna ge huꞌnova vayaꞌmo alisaya vayaꞌmo alagi oꞌmaiꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo alagi eꞌa oꞌnegae.
Alopa kateꞌmo neꞌutapa muki apakesaya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo hapa paitapaeꞌmo, neꞌyaꞌmo nekaeyategamo eyo, hutapa hapa paiyo, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Ani kava huꞌa aliꞌyaꞌamo neꞌaliya vayaꞌmogimo uꞌa hosu vayaꞌe alagepa vayaꞌeꞌmo apavaleli eꞌa apateꞌnageꞌa noꞌafiꞌmo maiꞌa kili paeꞌnae.
Ala neꞌapimo kini vekamoꞌa neꞌyateꞌmo haiꞌa maiꞌnaya vayaꞌmo apakesiyafeꞌmo haino ageyana aꞌmo neꞌaliya afinaꞌmo neꞌvaiya agufa kukenamo alino oꞌvaiꞌniya vekamo haino maiꞌnigeno agetenoꞌaeꞌmo,
Veꞌnimo, huno, haiya kava higeka aꞌmo neꞌaliya afinaꞌmo aliꞌa neꞌvaiya kukenamo alika oꞌvaika haikeka maiꞌnane, huno afi geꞌnigeno geꞌamo ohaneꞌniye.

Ala neꞌapimo kini vekamoꞌa aliꞌyaꞌamo neꞌaliya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo hapa painoꞌaeꞌmo, aiya ayateꞌmo nofi kitetapa alinitutapa malaga hani kopiꞌmo yaga autapa ataleyo. Ani koteꞌmo maisaya vayaꞌmogimo aviꞌya huge apavepiꞌmo hanige huꞌa maigae, huno huꞌniye, huno hapa paitenoꞌaeꞌmo,
Gotiꞌa asole vayaꞌaifeꞌmo eyo huno ge huꞌniyaꞌmonanafa aise vayaꞌmo lekana paino apateꞌniye, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Takesi monimo neꞌmalaya kavafeꞌmo ava gemo huꞌniya gemae
Falasi mono vayaꞌmo uꞌa aliꞌa anupa huꞌa maiꞌneꞌapaeꞌmo, na agufa geletiꞌmo amalageka hisunageno ge nehisigeta atafausune, huꞌa huteꞌa ge huge afige huꞌa maiꞌnae.

Apakaemo geꞌapimo neꞌafiya vayaꞌe Heloti geꞌamo akame nehaya vayaꞌeꞌmo aliꞌa apateꞌnageꞌa agaetegamo uꞌapaeꞌmo, Tisao, huꞌa, ago kageꞌnonana alagi lama geꞌageꞌmo nehana vekamo maiꞌneka Goti geꞌamo akame hisaya kavafeꞌmo lama geletiꞌmo alika apaya neꞌmalane. Muki vayaꞌaifeꞌmo koli osuka muki vayaꞌaitegamo magoke agufa kavaꞌageꞌmo nehana vekamo maiꞌnane.
Maiꞌnanaꞌmofeꞌmo yagaino nelateya gamani vekamo Sisaꞌmo takesi monimo alita amisupi oꞌamisune. Kagaemo na agufa ge, huka kagesamo neꞌafine, huꞌa afi geꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa hosu apaipa apakesa afiꞌnaya kavaꞌapimo ago apaketenoꞌaeꞌmo, aetapa ati nekaya vayaꞌmogitapae, huno, na kava higetapaeꞌmo aneꞌai hanagitapa natafaugefeꞌmo nehae.
Takesi nehaya monimo alitapa nave liyo, huno hapa paiꞌnigeꞌa mago alaga monimo aliꞌa ave liꞌnae.

Agaemo loka huno apafi geꞌniye. Mani alaga monileꞌmo ina la augosaꞌe agiꞌeꞌmo avoꞌmo kae maleꞌnaya agiꞌe augosaꞌeꞌmo haneꞌniye, huno apafi geꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo Sisa augosaꞌe agiꞌeꞌmo haneꞌniye, huꞌa ha paiꞌnageno Yesuꞌa, he, huno, haneꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo Sisa yaꞌamo Sisaꞌmo amitetapa Goti yaꞌamo Gotiꞌmo amiyo, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Ani gemo afiteꞌapaeꞌmo hapau aiteꞌa ataleꞌa uꞌnae.
Faliꞌnaya vayaꞌmo he tisaya kavafeꞌmo ge huꞌa afi geꞌnaya gemae
Ani afinaꞌmo mago Satiyusi mono vayaꞌmo Yesutegamo eꞌnae. Apakaemo faliꞌnaya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo he otigae, huꞌa apakesa neꞌafiya vayane.

Apakaemo, Tisao, huꞌa, Moseseꞌa alino apaya malenoꞌaeꞌmo, mago vekamoꞌmo a aliteno mafaꞌnemo alino oꞌateno ago falitesigenoꞌaeꞌmo aganaꞌamoꞌmo koguꞌamo aliteno faliꞌniya vekamo aimuꞌyaleꞌmo mafaꞌnemo alino apateno, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Mago afinaꞌmo seveniꞌa konaga anagaꞌmo maiꞌnae. Nepuꞌapimoꞌa aꞌmo aliteno mafaꞌnemo alino oꞌateno falitegenoꞌaeꞌmo aganaꞌamoꞌmo koguꞌamo aliꞌniye.
Aganaꞌamoꞌeꞌmo ani kava huno falitegeno agae akamelegati aganaꞌamogiꞌeꞌmo ani kava huꞌa falime falime uꞌa seveniꞌa konagamo alagi faliꞌa hano huꞌnae.
Falitagenoꞌaeꞌmo henagaꞌamo a kanomo faliꞌniye. Seveniꞌa konagamogi aliꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo faliꞌnayatetiꞌmo he tisaya afinaꞌmo haiya vekamo aꞌmo maigiye, huꞌa afi geꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa hapa painoꞌaeꞌmo, lapakaemo Goti Mukufi gemo oꞌafige Goti lokiyaꞌamo oꞌagege huꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo ika ika lapakesa neꞌafiye.
Faliꞌnaya vayaꞌmo he tiꞌapaeꞌmo aꞌmo oꞌalige veleꞌmo oꞌmaige hugayaꞌmonanafa kokuꞌnapi enisole vayakana huꞌa maigae.
Faliꞌnaya vayaꞌmo he tisaya kavafeꞌmo Gotiꞌa lapa paiꞌniya gemo mukuꞌafiꞌmo haneꞌniyana lekana paitapa oꞌafiꞌnafiye.

Gotiꞌa, Emalehamu Gotiꞌamoꞌnamo maige Aisiki Gotiꞌamoꞌnamo maige Yekopu Gotiꞌamoꞌnamo maige huꞌna maiꞌnove, huno huꞌniye. Agaemo faliꞌnaya vayaꞌai Gotiꞌapimoꞌmo oꞌmaiꞌnifa afaꞌa neꞌmaiya vayaꞌai Gotiꞌapimoꞌmo maiꞌniye, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Muki vayaꞌmogi ani gemo afiteꞌapaeꞌmo alino apaya maleꞌniya geꞌaeꞌmo hapau aiꞌnae.
Hogote keꞌaepa geꞌaeꞌmo huꞌniya gemae
Mago Falasi vayaꞌmo Yu monote neꞌyagaiya vayaꞌmo Yesutegamo eꞌa aliꞌa anupa huꞌa maiꞌnae.
Maiꞌneꞌapaeꞌmo apakaepatiꞌmo mago vekamoꞌa keꞌaepa gemo alagepa huno afiꞌneno alino apaya neꞌmaleya vekamoꞌmo amalageka huno afi gesiyafeꞌmo hunoꞌaeꞌmo,
Tisao, huno, muki keꞌaepa gefatiꞌmo hogote keꞌaepa gemo aeno aga seꞌniya keꞌaepa gemo haiya gemo haneꞌniye, huno afi geꞌniye.
Yesuꞌa, Ala kava neꞌmo Gotikamofeꞌmo muki kaipafatinagi muki kaunekamepatinagi muki kagesa afi yakafatinagi huno kahaino.
Mani keꞌaepa gemo hogote gemo haneꞌneno muki keꞌaepa geꞌamo ago aeno aga seꞌniye.

Napa tu keꞌaepa geꞌe napa vani keꞌaepa geꞌeꞌmo magoke agufa gelaꞌmo haneꞌniye. Napa tu keꞌaepa gemoꞌmo hunoꞌaeꞌmo, kagaikaeꞌmo kahau kayamopafiꞌmo nekahaiya kava huka kahaopale neꞌmaiya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo kahau kayamopafiꞌmo kahaino.
Mani lole keꞌaepa gelaꞌmoꞌa muki keꞌaepa geꞌamogi Gotitegati gemo alini eꞌa aeꞌa hakalo huꞌa hapa nepaiya vayaꞌai gemoꞌmogi huno aepaꞌalaꞌmo haneꞌnaꞌae, huno ha paiꞌniye.
Kalaisi neꞌmo ina la mafaꞌneꞌamo maiꞌniye, huno apafi geꞌniya gemae
Yesuꞌa aliꞌa anupa huꞌa maiꞌnaya Falasi mono vayaꞌaifeꞌmo apafi geꞌniye.
Kalaisi nefeꞌmo haiya agufa lapakesa neꞌafiye, huno huteno, ina la mafaꞌneꞌamo maiꞌniye, hutapa lapakesa neꞌafiye, huno apafi geꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo,

Nevini mafaꞌnelupatiꞌmo aginago neꞌamo maiꞌniye, huꞌa huꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo, Nevini aginagoꞌamo maiꞌnisiꞌmoꞌmo haiya kava higeno Neviniꞌa Goti Aunemeꞌamoꞌa alino amiꞌniya geꞌaletiꞌmo Kalaisi nefeꞌmo hunoꞌaeꞌmo, kava neꞌnie, huno huꞌniye.
Neviniꞌa ani geeꞌmo hunoꞌaeꞌmo,

content.text: Ala kava neꞌmoꞌa Ala kava neꞌnieꞌmo hunoꞌaeꞌmo, lamaga nahaopaleꞌmo faika maime maime neꞌugeꞌnao kamekamo apamagisugeꞌa kaiya afeꞌalumelaga maigayanagi, huno huꞌniye.

content: Neviniꞌa Kalaisi nefeꞌmo kava neꞌnie, huno huꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo haiya kava huno ma mopafi aginago neꞌamo maiꞌniye, huno apafi geꞌnigeꞌa
geꞌaleꞌmo aeꞌa atagaina huꞌa ha paisaya agufa geꞌapimo alagi ohaneꞌniye. Ani afinatetiꞌmo koli huꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo magoꞌe huꞌa loka huꞌa afi okeꞌnae.
